info.name: Pizza FPT — Ahamove staging
info.description: Local backend contract. Configure backend Ahamove staging, real catalog IDs, Firebase customer/staff tokens and Firestore rules/index first. Get a new quote when changing checkout or paymentMethod. Run COD or payOS path separately. Advancing/dispatching requires staffUid allowlist. payOS QR uses existing payment configuration and is not a simulated bank payment. Never store production secrets here.

request.description: Set paymentMethod to COD or PAYOS before this step. Use a product and variant that exist in Firestore. Omit variantId in this body for products without variants. Address is a demo destination; replace contact with your staging test recipient.

exec: pm.test('Server quote includes delivery fee', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const q = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(q.environment).to.eql('staging'); pm.expect(q.pricing.total).to.eql(q.pricing.subtotal + q.pricing.deliveryFee); pm.collectionVariables.set('quoteId', q.id); const input = JSON.parse(pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.body.raw)); pm.collectionVariables.set('payosCheckout', JSON.stringify({...input.checkout, deliveryQuoteId: q.id})); });

item.name: 2b. payOS create/retry (use PAYOS quote; pay QR before staff steps)

exec: pm.test('QR payment includes shipping', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(order.pricing.subtotal + order.pricing.deliveryFee); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', order.id); });

item.name: 4. Staff advance kitchen (run three times: CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY)

request.description: First call creates a staging trip only when READY. Further calls only look up the existing tracking number, never repeat create POST. UNKNOWN booking requires portal reconciliation.

exec: pm.test('Staging trip linked', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d = pm.response.json().delivery; pm.expect(d.environment).to.eql('staging'); pm.collectionVariables.set('providerOrderId', d.providerOrderId); });
pm.test('Customer reads authoritative delivery state', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().delivery.provider).to.eql('AHAMOVE'); });
pm.test('Customer cannot book a driver', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
